scripts.build: if [ -d 'helpdesk/public/desk/assets' ] && [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pre-built artifacts present at helpdesk/public/desk/assets (set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force rebuild)'; else yarn build:force; fi
scripts.enable-workspaces: sed -i '' 's/"aworkspaces"/"workspaces"/g' package.json && rm -rf node_modules ./desk/node_modules/ frappe-ui/node_modules/ && yarn install
